cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm taking you to lunch, just us. That family reunion was a disaster we needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. No audience this time. I'll get us something to eat; you start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Start? You haven't even asked what I want to eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, I'll put my menu down. Order yours first; mine can wait.

reason: Owner-flagged repair pass 1: remove unsupported waiter headcount and change claim; give B an immediate concern about A ordering for both. A5 enacts yielding the floor rather than stating a general lesson. A1/A3 retain the specific healthy interpretation of the failed reunion.
